acceptance: make worktree-reap prints one line per linked worktree with its verdict (remove, keep, or ambiguous) and the reason, and changes nothing
APPLY=1 removes only worktrees the dry run marks remove, with the same per-worktree checks as make worktree-finish APPLY=1, and prints what it removed
The primary clone, the current worktree, locked worktrees, and worktrees with uncommitted, untracked, or unpushed work are never removed
Tests cover each verdict and the refusal cases
context: Merged in PR #3133. Owner decision 2026-10-18 (chat): "Arm, then sweep". Sweep run 2026-10-18 with make worktree-reap APPLY=1: 111 worktrees and their local branches removed, 0 failures; registered worktrees 181 -> 70 (then 69 after finishing the reaper's own worktree). Remaining verdicts: 36 keep (open PRs, dirty, current, primary), 34 ambiguous: 15 detached HEAD, 9 legacy provenance, 5 merged-PR head mismatch, 2 malformed provenance, 1 lookup failure, 1 HEAD mismatch, 1 no merged PR. Ambiguous worktrees need owner review; they are never removed automatically.
description: Local linked worktrees accumulate because close-out removes them one at a time with make worktree-finish, and that step is often skipped. Add make worktree-reap: a dry run lists every linked worktree whose branch is merged or deleted on origin and that has no uncommitted or unpushed work; APPLY=1 removes those worktrees and their local branches; anything ambiguous is reported for the owner, never removed. Build on the existing worktree-audit and worktree-finish evaluation so the safety rules stay in one place.
